name: dedup-subtitle
note: Both de-duplication rules *rewrite* the metadata as a side effect, and the rewrite is what the gate has to see: a heading matching an ellipsised title replaces the title (core.py:261-263), and a paragraph matching a complete subtitle replaces the subtitle (core.py:277-279). Here the replacement differs from the original by one character in each case, so a port that drops the paragraph without performing the rewrite fails.
